identity_boundaries: Device Reference may exist forever without a Network Element resolution.
Regularization links a Device Reference to exactly one registered Network Element without rewriting the operational Device Reference identity/history.
Network Element identity is not derived from model, serial, IP, Rack, Cloud, hostname, external workbook row, or containment position.
Installed Component identity is not the reusable compatibility/BOM template identity.

An operational HLD-08 Device Part Unit may exist without registered Infrastructure; when it corresponds to a registered Installed Component, an explicit resolution relation links the two immutable identities without merge or ownership transfer.
physical_boundaries: Site is the authoritative physical Site for every registered Network Element.
Room belongs to one Site; Rack belongs to one Room and therefore derives one Site.
Network Element Rack placement must resolve to the same authoritative Site.
Containment and Rack placement are independent relationships and neither implies the other.
